title: Kusarigama
description: Every time you play [blue]3[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, deal [blue]6[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks the number of Attack cards played in a single turn. When attacks played reaches a multiple of the threshold (default 3), the relic triggers and deals damage to a randomly selected hittable enemy. The counter resets at the end of each player turn via the AfterSideTurnEnd hook. Display shows progress toward triggering (e.g., 1/3, 2/3).
